use_case: Reach an independently deployed Nimble SGLang decision endpoint without teaching the gateway its trained prompt format.
proposal: HTTP passthrough to the existing /v1/systemone. All SGLang and NimbleCompiler work remains upstream. Declare 2-26 criteria and 64 questions. Preserve question IDs and option order exactly; explicitly disclose that these affect inference. Preserve entropy confidence; do not assert calibration or semantic equivalence under ID renaming. Native endpoint enforces token limits. No fallback or compiler reimplementation.

evidence.facts: Imports openjev application factory, SGLang client and evaluation service. Exposes the decision endpoint and nimble-latest alias. Documents Choice/Noul/Score, 26 candidates, 64 questions, entropy concentration confidence and question IDs/keys in the trained prompt. Checks prompt source hash against checkpoint contract.

validation: Source inspection only. No Nimble endpoint supplied or tested. Pin the checkpoint and runtime independently; test native parity and characterize ID/order behavior.
